title: RequestOrganizerDomainCallablePayload
description: An organiser owner reserves a hostname for the organiser page (#1110). Only an owner of a claimed or verified organiser with no other non-removed domain may call it, while the custom-domains switch is on. Returns OrganizerDomainCallableResponse with the DNS instructions.

hostname.description: The domain as the owner typed it. The server normalises it, then rejects anything that is not a servedHostname or that the blocklist holds.

x-normalization: trim whitespace and lowercase the hostname
reject schemes, ports, paths, wildcards, IP addresses and IDN or punycode labels
compute the registrable domain from the Public Suffix List; a bare registrable domain becomes www.<domain> with a registrar apex redirect
